snippet.title: Australia Did It | Indie Fan Fest | Feb 2026
snippet.description:
Welcome aboard mercenary! At Ocean Traffic Collaboration (OTC), cargo is king…. mercenaries, not so much. Decades ago, something mysterious dried up the Atlantic Ocean, leaving behind a hostile wasteland crawling with oversized bugs, rogue ancient weapons, and bizarre mutated creatures. Your mission: ensure our valuable cargo reaches its destination safely. Your survival? Entirely optional.

Australia Did It reinvents the reverse bullet hell genre, blending thoughtful station defense with explosive, pulse-pounding RTS combat. Carefully strategize to withstand relentless enemy waves, then unleash sensory overload as you become the Bullet Hell, mowing down thousands in dazzling chaos.
